serial_number.ask: Spectrometer serial number (Enter for the first one found on USB)
serial_number.help: Printed on the label under the unit and shown by `seabreeze_os_setup` / OceanView. Only needed when more than one spectrometer is plugged into this host.

data_dir.ask: Folder where spectra are saved as CSV
data_dir.help: Any folder this host can write. Each acquire and acquire_dark writes one file named by date, kind and job id.
